svg.aria-label: One bench holds the whole service line, with one route across it. At the front left, a Tcules designer holds a lifted lime board with a wireframe laid out on it, and a dashed line runs from it into the screen of a laptop at the back: a light laptop whose dark blue screen shows a working product with a chart, cards and an AI panel. From the laptop a second dashed line runs on to a blue phone, where a second Tcules designer stands with a hand on it. Database cylinders sit against the laptop. Beside it stands a faded earlier screen on its stand, two issues marked on it and one item carried across to the new screen by a dotted line. Along the front edge lie a tray of five interface parts and a component beside its code panel.
